fusions.name: Burrow Burst
fusions.desc: Sends a mole-run racing under the ground to the first enemy within 7 tiles, where it erupts for 28 earth damage. Enemies within 3.5 tiles of the eruption take 80% of that.

fusions.name: Come Up Beneath
fusions.desc: You burrow up to 5 tiles to the target and come up beneath it, dealing 11 earth damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaving each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Tunnel Through
fusions.desc: Tunnels you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. You gain 8% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Deep Galleries
fusions.desc: Your movement speed rises by 8%, and you have 10% earth resistance.
